Out of all the presenters, two in particular stuck out to me - the Irish speaker and the Honduran speaker. One because his talk was so engaging, the other because he was clearly drunk. The Honduran speaker spoke first and I had really high hopes for the rest of the meeting after hearing his great talk. But then the Irish speaker went second, slurring all his words and nearly falling off the stage. Who was the engaging speaker?
A. The Irish speaker
B. The Honduran speaker
C. Unknown
